natural_body: Price-sensitive SMB 40% off: signups +31%, rev +18%, retention -12%.

first.rationale: Onboarding simplification is the best-supported direction for addressing both current declines: memory_86 links shorter onboarding to completion and early adoption, while memory_31 links fewer signup requirements to durable activation gains. A standard experiment is warranted, but long-term qualified-revenue impact still needs validation rather than assuming early adoption will translate downstream.
